name: Input
description: Type and click on the desktop on the user's behalf (keyboard and mouse), through the desktop's remote-desktop portal.
author: PAI

changelog.summary: First release: keyboard and mouse control for agents, with the desktop's own approval dialog.
features: input.start asks the desktop for permission once; the compositor shows its own approval dialog and remote-control indicator
keyboard.type, keyboard.key (shortcuts such as ctrl+l), mouse.move, mouse.click, mouse.scroll
Coordinates can be given in screenshot pixels (spaceWidth/spaceHeight) and are mapped onto the shared screens

capabilities.description: Ask the desktop for permission to type and click for the user. The desktop shows its own approval dialog; the user must approve (and should share ALL screens if they have several). Must be called once before any keyboard or mouse capability. Returns which devices and screens were granted.
capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to control your keyboard and mouse. Your desktop will ask you to approve; you can revoke it at any time.

capabilities.description: Show whether keyboard/mouse control is active and which screens are shared (x, y, w, h in desktop pixels).
End keyboard/mouse control immediately (the desktop's approval is released).
Type text into whatever has keyboard focus. Newline presses Return, tab presses Tab. Up to 500 characters.
capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to type text on your computer.

capabilities.description: Press a key or shortcut, e.g. 'Return', 'Escape', 'Tab', 'Left', 'F5', 'ctrl+l', 'ctrl+shift+t', 'alt+Left'. Modifiers: ctrl, shift, alt, super.

keys.description: Key or combo joined with '+'. Write the plus key as 'plus'.

capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to press keys on your computer.

capabilities.description: Move the mouse pointer. Give x and y; add spaceWidth/spaceHeight when they are positions in a screenshot.

spaceWidth.description: Width of the coordinate space x is in, e.g. the screenshot's width. Omit to use desktop pixels.

spaceHeight.description: Height of the coordinate space y is in, e.g. the screenshot's height.

capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to move your mouse pointer.

capabilities.description: Click a mouse button, optionally at a position (x, y) first. Add spaceWidth/spaceHeight when x/y are positions in a screenshot. Double click = count 2.

spaceWidth.description: Width of the coordinate space x is in, e.g. the screenshot's width. Omit to use desktop pixels.

spaceHeight.description: Height of the coordinate space y is in, e.g. the screenshot's height.

capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to click with your mouse.

capabilities.description: Scroll the wheel by whole steps: dy positive = down, negative = up; dx for sideways. Optionally move to (x, y) first so the scroll lands there.

spaceWidth.description: Width of the coordinate space x is in, e.g. the screenshot's width. Omit to use desktop pixels.

spaceHeight.description: Height of the coordinate space y is in, e.g. the screenshot's height.

capabilities.confirmationReason: PAI wants to scroll with your mouse.
